create_banmo_model: create a BanMo neural scene graph model with NeRF shape, appearance, and motion modules for non-rigid 3D reconstruction
run_nerf_render: run NeRF ray rendering with coarse and fine sampling to compute image, silhouette, and feature losses
compute_root_poses: compute and refine root body poses using CNN, MLP, or explicit basis with delta SE3 transformations
sample_pixels_for_training: sample pixels with uncertainty-guided importance sampling and ray casting for NeRF training optimization
render_densepose_features: render DensePose canonical surface embedding features from a 3D mesh using soft rendering and camera projection
